ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 10th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position at ICAR IARI.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the SRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree in Genetics, Plant Breeding, Genetics and Plant Breeding, or Biotechnology, with a 4 or 5-year bachelor's degree as per ICAR guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Research Fellow post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an age relaxation of five years for SC/ST and women candidates, and three years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the SRF post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000 + HRA for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 + HRA for the third year.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the ICAR IARI SRF position?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview with all required documents on the specified date.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates, along with self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the ICAR IARI located?
faq.answer: ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110012.
